text: どろぼう　ポケモンが　いりゃ　ぜひ　つかって　みたいねー！

structure.jp: どろぼう　ポケモンが　いりゃ
structure.en: if there were a thief Pokémon

structure.jp: ぜひ　つかって　みたいねー！
structure.en: I'd sure love to try using it!

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: いりゃ is a slurred spoken form of いれば, where ば means 'if'. ポケモンが　いりゃ = 'if there were a Pokémon'.

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: みる after a verb's て form means trying something out to see what it is like. つかって　みたい = 'I want to try using it'.

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on the end of a verb means 'want to'. みたい = 'want to try'.
